mapper.sql:
, unique_keys AS ( SELECT sscsdm,bridge_key,min(bridge_id) AS bridge_id FROM bridge_keys GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)=1 ), target_keys AS ( SELECT * FROM unique_keys WHERE
bridge_id IN #{bid} 1=0
bridge_id=#{bridgeId}
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bridge_active b WHERE b.qlid=unique_keys.bridge_id) ), candidate_keys AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT r.sscsdm,r.bsm FROM
r JOIN target_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.]::text[] WHERE nullif(trim(r.bsm),'') IS NOT NULL AND r.bsm=#{recordId} ), candidate_versions AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT r.* FROM
r JOIN candidate_keys c ON c.sscsdm=r.sscsdm AND c.bsm=r.bsm WHERE r.bsm=#{recordId} ), source_latest AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(r.sscsdm,r.bsm) r.* FROM candidate_versions r ORDER BY r.sscsdm,r.bsm,r.tbsj DESC NULLS LAST,(r.sjtbzt='D') DESC NULLS LAST, r.extract_time DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), records AS ( SELECT r.bsm AS id,#{kind}::text AS kind,r.sscsdm AS city_code,k.bridge_id,b.qlmc AS bridge_name, r.
AS source_bridge_key,r.tbsj AS source_updated_at,r.sjtbzt AS sync_status,r.bz AS note,
r.jcrq AS occurred_at,r.rcxcbsm AS task_id,NULL::text AS code,r.jcdy AS unit,r.jcxm AS item_text,r.jcff AS method, r.jcnr AS content,r.jcjg AS result,r.czyh AS hazard,NULL::integer AS zone,NULL::integer AS item, NULL::integer AS damage_type,NULL::integer AS origin,NULL::integer AS severity,NULL::integer AS status, NULL::text AS description,NULL::text AS quantity,NULL::text AS location,NULL::integer AS maintenance_type, NULL::date AS rectified_date,r.fj AS attachment_raw
r.sbrq::timestamp AS occurred_at,NULL::text AS task_id,r.bhbh AS code,NULL::text AS unit,NULL::text AS item_text, NULL::text AS method,NULL::text AS content,NULL::text AS result,NULL::text AS hazard,r.qlbw AS zone,r.xjx AS item, r.shlx AS damage_type,r.bhly AS origin,r.shcd AS severity,r.clzt AS status,r.bhms AS description,r.dlms AS quantity, r.wzms AS location,NULL::integer AS maintenance_type,NULL::date AS rectified_date,r.bhtp AS attachment_raw
r.yhrq::timestamp AS occurred_at,NULL::text AS task_id,r.bhbh AS code,r.yhdw AS unit,NULL::text AS item_text, NULL::text AS method,NULL::text AS content,NULL::text AS result,NULL::text AS hazard,NULL::integer AS zone, NULL::integer AS item,NULL::integer AS damage_type,NULL::integer AS origin,NULL::integer AS severity, r.wtzgzt AS status,NULL::text AS description,NULL::text AS quantity,NULL::text AS location,r.yhlx AS maintenance_type, r.wtzgrq AS rectified_date,r.wxhzp AS attachment_raw
FROM source_latest r JOIN target_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.]::text[] JOIN bridge_active b ON b.qlid=k.bridge_id WHERE coalesce(r.sjtbzt,'')!='D' )

(r.occurred_at IS NULL OR r.occurred_at::date>(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date OR r.source_updated_at IS NULL OR coalesce(r.sync_status,'') NOT IN ('','I','U')
OR nullif(trim(r.result),'') IS NULL
OR nullif(trim(r.code),'') IS NULL OR r.status IS NULL OR r.status NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 6
OR r.zone IS NULL OR r.zone NOT IN (1,2,3,99) OR r.item IS NULL OR (r.item NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9 AND r.item!=99) OR r.damage_type IS NULL OR (r.damage_type NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 35 AND r.damage_type!=99) OR r.origin IS NULL OR r.origin NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR r.severity IS NULL OR r.severity NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 OR nullif(trim(r.description),'') IS NULL
OR r.maintenance_type IS NULL OR r.maintenance_type NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR r.rectified_date<r.occurred_at::date
)
mapper.select:
SELECT,count(*) OVER() AS matching_total FROM records r
ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT,NULL::bigint AS matching_total FROM records r WHERE id=#{recordId}
